DIVIDEND POLICY                                                                   股息政策
The Company has a dividend policy, the objective of which is to allow             本公司的股息政策之目標為讓股東分享盈利，
the Shareholders to participate in the Company’s profits whilst retaining         同時保留足夠的儲備維持本集團日後發展。本

For the year ended 31 December 2018 截至二零一八年十二月三十一日止年度

1.    GENERAL                                                                1.   一般資料
      Kingboard Holdings Limited (the “Company”) is a public limited              建滔集團有限公司（「本公司」）在開曼群
      company incorporated in the Cayman Islands and its shares are listed        島註冊成立為上市有限公司，其股份在
      on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited                香港聯合交易所有限公司（「聯交所」）之
      (the “Stock Exchange”). The addresses of the registered office and          主板上市。本公司註冊辦事處之地址及
      principal place of business of the Company are disclosed in the             主要營業地點於本年報「公司資料」一節
      “Corporate Information” section of the annual report.                       中披露。

      The Company is an investment holding company and the principal              本公司為投資控股公司，其附屬公司之
      activities of its subsidiaries are set out in Note 47.                      主要業務載於附註47。

      The principal activities of its subsidiaries are the manufacture and         其附屬公司主要從事覆銅面板、印刷線

     deferred tax liabilities are not recognised if the temporary difference

     associated with investments in subsidiaries and associates and                      公司之投資及合營公司權益有關之應課

      Critical judgements in applying accounting policies                              應用會計政策之重大判斷

14. INVESTMENT PROPERTIES (continued)                                             14. 投資物業（續）
     In determining the fair value of the relevant properties, the Directors             為釐定相關物業的公平值，董事會已成
     has set up a valuation committee, which is headed up by the                         立估值委員會，由負責本集團財務事務
     persons in charge of financial matters of the Group, to determine                   的人士帶領，以就公平值計量釐定適當
     the appropriate valuation techniques and inputs for fair value                      的估值技術及輸入數據。
     measurements.

     The Group engages an independent valuer to perform its valuations.                  本集團聘請一名獨立估值師進行估值。
     The valuation committee works closely with the independent valuer                   估值委員會與獨立估值師緊密合作，為
     to establish the appropriate valuation techniques and inputs to the                 估值模式建立適當的估值技術及輸入數
     model. The persons in charge of financial matters reports the valuation             據。負責財務事務的人士每季向董事報
     committee’s findings to the Directors every quarter to explain the                  告估值委員會的發現，以解釋資產及負
     cause of fluctuations in the fair value of the assets and liabilities.              債公平值的波動原因。

     The Group’s investment properties were classified as Level 3 of the                 於二零一八年十二月三十一日及二零
     fair value hierarchy as at 31 December 2018 and 31 December 2017.                   一七年十二月三十一日，本集團之投資
                                                                                         物業分類為第三類公平值等級。

     The following table gives information about how the fair values                     下表載列該等投資物業之公平值釐定方

     valuation technique and inputs used), as well as the fair value                     以及按公平值計量輸入數據的可觀察程
     hierarchy into which the fair value measurements are categorised                    度將公平值計量分類之公平值架構級別
